rationale: Bill is building real-time AI perception and LLM efficiency at General Instinct, while John brings deep cloud infrastructure expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure) and conviction that cloud-native systems are foundational for enterprise AI adoption. John's operational and systems-level background could complement Bill's applied ML research focus, particularly as General Instinct scales from early-stage research into production deployment.
intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet John Komarnicki — you're both operating at the intersection of AI and infrastructure (Bill on LLM efficiency and real-time perception, John on cloud-native ops and ML systems), and his cloud and DevOps depth could be valuable as you move from research into deployed products.
